purpose: Machine-readable catalog of AutostopManager memory and routing MCP tools used by the manager agent.
memory_is_source_of_truth_for: routing rules distilled from approved source files

tool_contracts.remember: Store long-term manager memory that does not belong in AutoStop CRM cards; prefer distilled conclusions over raw source copies; facts may carry confidence.
tool_contracts.recall: Search memory with relevance scoring and optional kind/category/tag filters before assuming owner context, style preferences, operating lessons, or durable rules are unknown.
tool_contracts.learn_from_feedback: Store a concise reusable lesson after strong owner feedback, praise, criticism, clear success, or clear failure; store the lesson, not raw CRM/Gmail/event copies.
tool_contracts.recall_lessons: Search reusable manager lessons by query, applies_to, signal, and tags before similar work.
tool_contracts.memory_map: Return compact counts and sections for manager memory so the agent can navigate memory before broad recall.
tool_contracts.memory_topics: Return memory categories and tags with counts and examples for navigation and review.
tool_contracts.memory_context_for: Build compact memory context for a task: relevant preferences, rules, lessons, source boundaries, and suggested use; treat as context, not a template.
tool_contracts.memory_gaps: Return sparse or empty memory areas and review prompts without copying CRM or Gmail data.
tool_contracts.add_manager_task: Create a durable task that is not a CRM card or repair order.
tool_contracts.today_context: Return open tasks, due reminders, recent journal entries, and the current rule set.
tool_contracts.prepare_manager_context: Combine owner command routes, relevant memory/rules, knowledge routing, missing required context, and next actions for a specific request.
tool_contracts.agent_brief: Return the mandatory compact startup package for an agent before broad document reads or CRM work: role, route, memory_sources, source boundaries, hot rules, read order, allowed/forbidden actions, missing context, next actions, and verification.
tool_contracts.manager_journal: Append a concise factual note after important work, source changes, or decisions.
tool_contracts.sync_knowledge_base: Refresh the SQLite index of docs/agent/knowledge_map.json routes, playbooks, source catalogs, and model-specific skills.
tool_contracts.probe_knowledge_base: Cheaply test whether local knowledge exists for a vehicle, model, system, brand, fluid, diagnostic, parts, CRM, or source-intake task; if has_knowledge=true, open open_first/source_of_truth first; for routes with optional_runtime_files, report available/missing runtime files before claiming exact private facts.
tool_contracts.search_knowledge_base: Search indexed knowledge sections after probing; optionally filter by domain such as fluids, automotive_repair, bmw_repair, bmw_f15_n63, toyota_gr_yaris, or vehicle_identity_and_oem.
tool_contracts.audit_knowledge_base: Check knowledge_map.json, route-card metadata, mapped files, SQLite index counts, and FTS health after source intake or route edits.
tool_contracts.audit_knowledge_annotations: Check docs/agent/knowledge_annotations.jsonl compact file-level annotations and their domain coverage.
tool_contracts.audit_skill_registry: Check local Codex skill files linked from knowledge_map.json and report missing or unlinked skills.
tool_contracts.system_audit: Run the canonical read-only AutoStop Manager health layer: knowledge audit, annotations audit, skills audit, cleanup dry-run summary, local SQLite stats, MCP catalog consistency, and tests_status=external.
tool_contracts.cleanup_audit: Run the dry-run cleanup audit for caches, duplicate PDFs, unreferenced agent docs, local DB size, and overindexed source packs; never deletes or moves files.
tool_contracts.crm_health_plan: Build a read-only CRM health plan from already fetched board_context, board_review, and today_context payloads; never calls live CRM write tools and reports cards_moved=0 and cards_archived=0.
tool_contracts.audit_memory: Check long-term manager memory for duplicate, expired, and superseded note/fact records before cleanup.
tool_contracts.curate_memory: Non-destructively curate manager memory; with apply=true, archive duplicate note/fact copies instead of deleting source records.
tool_contracts.start_manager_run: Start an auditable run for autopilot, procurement, finance, CRM, or knowledge work.
tool_contracts.record_manager_run_event: Record planned actions, writes, skips, risks, and verification events for a manager run.
tool_contracts.finish_manager_run: Close a manager run with status, summary, and verification evidence.
tool_contracts.list_manager_runs: List recent manager runs and optionally include their events.
tool_contracts.lookup_original_parts: Classify VIN, chassis, or market code and return a source-aware OEM lookup route.
tool_contracts.decode_vehicle_identity: Build a source-aware vehicle identity dossier from VIN/frame/body number: identifier classification, check digit/model-year diagnostics, vPIC/WMI/platform evidence, CRM-context conflicts, confidence label, adapter status, and required EPC/API sources before VIN-critical parts lookup.
tool_contracts.decode_vehicle_identities: Batch vehicle identity dossiers for VIN/frame/body-number lists without durable raw VIN persistence; uses public vPIC batch when enabled and reports batch coverage for CRM board scans.
tool_contracts.catalog_provider_status: Report configured VIN/OEM/cross/procurement provider readiness by stage without exposing secret values; use before claiming live catalog or supplier API access.
tool_contracts.plan_oem_parts_providers: Build provider readiness and blocker plan for VIN/frame -> OEM candidates -> crosses/applicability -> procurement/RF market price. It redacts identifiers and does not call suppliers or write CRM.
tool_contracts.vin17_decode_vehicle: Call or dry-run the configured 17VIN API vehicle decoder using VIN17_ACCOUNT/VIN17_SECRET; expose only redacted request evidence and never expose token/secret.
tool_contracts.vin17_search_part_number_by_vin: Call or dry-run 17VIN search_part_number by VIN after a 17VIN decode returns an EPC code; use for read-only fitment checks, not supplier orders.
tool_contracts.partsapi_catalog_lookup: Call or dry-run PartsAPI VIN/OE/applicability/cross lookup using PARTSAPI_BASE_URL plus PARTSAPI_KEY or a method-specific PARTSAPI_*_KEY; supports VINdecode, VINdecodeOE, getPartsbyVIN, getOEApplicability, getCrosses, getCrossesWithBrand, and searchArticles without exposing key values.
tool_contracts.public_aftermarket_catalog_lookup: Call public MANN-FILTER and DENSO Aftermarket catalogs by part/OE number; use for brand-scope catalog enrichment, not as VIN-specific OEM EPC proof or supplier price confirmation.
tool_contracts.exist_price_lookup: Call or dry-run public read-only Exist article lookup for catalog disambiguation, analog visibility, retail price benchmark, and lead time with Krasnoyarsk office 905 by default; returns public_retail_reference only and never supplier-order data.
tool_contracts.lookup_oem_catalog_candidates: Call or dry-run the multi-provider OEM candidate lookup for one VIN/frame and requested part, combining Parts-Catalogs, PartsAPI, and 17VIN when credentials and routing ids are available; no CRM writes or supplier orders are created.
tool_contracts.benchmark_vin_parts_lookup: Read-only batch benchmark for CRM VIN/frame/body-number items: identity confidence, part-intent recognition, safe public search templates, provider blockers, and PartsAPI/17VIN dry-run readiness with raw identifiers redacted from output.
tool_contracts.build_vin_parts_work_order: Build read-only per-card VIN/frame parts lookup work orders: exact OEM/EPC routes, prepared API checks, cross/applicability steps, supplier routes, CRM writeback gates, blockers, and acceptance checklists with raw identifiers redacted from output.
tool_contracts.recommend_automotive_sources: Select authoritative repair or technical source routes by brand and data type.
tool_contracts.recommend_fluid_maintenance_sources: Select source routes for oils, fluids, capacities, and ТО planning.
tool_contracts.recommend_service_management_actions: Build a Krasnoyarsk workshop-management action plan for parts procurement, repair triage, staff load, customer flow, finance control, daily CRM control, or knowledge intake.
tool_contracts.plan_crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup: Build a deterministic CRM VIN/frame/body-number parts lookup workflow: live card intake, vehicle identification, OEM/replacement/cross lookup, procurement/RF market quote matrix, selected-part material line policy, CRM writeback steps, and reread verification. This planner does not write CRM or place supplier orders.
tool_contracts.estimate_repair_work_cost: Build a read-only labor estimate from vehicle/work items, public Russia STO labor-only prices, and a public norm-hours/labor-time plausibility layer; returns normalized operations, market sample, labor-time checks, Russia average, AutoStop +50% price, confidence, missing context, and next actions without writing repair orders.
tool_contracts.control_report: Generate ControlReportV1 with server/runtime/Codex readiness, system health, git state, tests/doctor route, memory/knowledge/MCP/provider readiness, production ops gates, ports, risks, and last run ledger; read-only and secrets-redacted.
tool_contracts.memory_review: Generate rule-based MemoryReviewItem proposals for duplicates, expired/superseded items, weak confidence, and run-ledger lesson candidates without copying raw CRM, email, or secret content.
tool_contracts.memory_review_apply: Apply a MemoryReviewItem decision: accept, reject, or archive_duplicate. Duplicate archival is non-destructive and never deletes source memory records.
tool_contracts.knowledge_intake_plan: Classify a source file into KnowledgeIntakeDraft with domain, source type, safety flags, target metadata updates, and required follow-up audits; apply mode is review-gated and does not commit raw private files.
tool_contracts.provider_smoke_report: Generate ProviderSmokeResult readiness checks for one provider or all providers in dry-run or live-readonly mode without order, basket, supplier write, or CRM writeback endpoints.

Приберись.authority: full board-management autopilot with strict preservation of user-entered CRM data
Приберись.automation_behavior: When scheduled hourly, run as an incremental control pass: inspect live CRM state, prioritize blockers and stale cards, write only meaningful deltas, avoid duplicate AI notes, and skip writes if CRM/MCP health or target identity is uncertain.
allowed_actions: rewrite public descriptions with supported rich text formatting and restrained emoji markers
update the separate hidden board_summary preview
leave archive recommendations when a card looks completed
forbidden_actions: move cards between columns unless the owner gives a separate explicit owner command
archive cards unless the owner gives a separate explicit owner command
put phone, VIN, full client identity, raw scan dumps, or long issue lists into board_summary

workflow: use probe_knowledge_base before broad file reads
update index/map routes when adding durable knowledge
update compact annotations when a file should be found by fast routing
run sync_knowledge_base after durable docs/catalog/skill changes
run audit_knowledge_base after route-card or source changes
inspect docs/agent/crm_manager_data_playbook.md before summarizing client, cashbox, repair-order, or CRM-statistics data
keep raw CRM data in live CRM or local private runtime files unless the owner explicitly approves an exact private export

command_routes.rule: Natural owner command aliases must map to an intent, domain, open_first file, memory queries, and next actions before broad knowledge search.

memory_guidance: keep only durable conclusions from new files
use memory_context_for before context-sensitive CRM, Gmail, writing-style, owner-preference, or repeated workflow decisions
recall owner preferences, style rules, and operating lessons before context-sensitive CRM or email work
use learn_from_feedback after strong praise, criticism, success, failure, or owner instruction to do something differently
store lessons as short reusable guidance, not full event copies or rigid output templates
store source routes, not copied databases
use importance, confidence, expires_at, supersedes_id, sensitivity, and tags when storing durable memory
run audit_memory when recall quality looks weak or before memory cleanup
use curate_memory apply=true only for non-destructive duplicate archiving
refresh the relevant catalog when the MCP surface changes
treat the owner's Приберись command as docs/agent/board_cleanup_autopilot_playbook.md
phone ChatGPT access uses the same CRM MCP endpoint when AutostopManager is mounted on the server
route management, procurement, staff, customer, and finance work through docs/agent/krasnoyarsk_service_management_playbook.md
route private ИП/AutoStop business identity and requisites through docs/agent/business_identity_playbook.md and data/private_knowledge
prefer explicit uncertainty over invented completeness
route CRM VIN/frame/body-number parts lookup through docs/agent/crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_playbook.md
use decode_vehicle_identity before OEM/parts lookup when CRM vehicle identity is incomplete, ROW/JDM, or confidence is unclear
use benchmark_vin_parts_lookup for 10-card or batch VIN/frame quality checks before claiming lookup coverage improved
use build_vin_parts_work_order after benchmark when the next step is actionable OEM/cross/supplier search by card
use catalog_provider_status and plan_oem_parts_providers before claiming that live VIN/OEM/supplier APIs are available
do not store raw customer VIN/frame values or supplier quote dumps from parts lookup in durable memory
